scripts.dev: npm run assets:build && npm run scenario:build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev VITE_XSTORYPHONE_RESET_FOR_TESTING=true vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build:cloudflare:target: npm run assets:build && npm run scenario:build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs vite build
scripts.build:aws: npm run assets:build && npm run scenario:build && BUILD_PLATFORM=aws vite build
scripts.check: npm run assets:build && npm run scenario:build && npm run audit:client && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run assets:build && npm run scenario:build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply xstoryphone-dev --local --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:remote:dev: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply xstoryphone-dev --remote --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:remote:stg: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply xstoryphone-stg --remote --env stg
scripts.db:migrate:remote:prod: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler d1 migrations apply xstoryphone --remote --env prod
